As per your request, please find below the 2-month rates for the 2-bedroom apartment at The Residences W3, Downtown Dubai:

October: AED 25,000
November: AED 35,000

Please note that the booking will be processed on a monthly basis, with each month consisting of 30 nights.

Thank you, and please let us know if you would like to proceed. We will be happy to assist you with the next steps.
